notes.title: [V1.02.06 Update Notes] Bug Fixes and Experience Optimization
notes.content:
Hello, Agent. 
Thank you for all the feedback you've provided. We have made some fixes and adjustments in this update
[list]

[*]  Fixed the issue where the item panel could not be scrolled in the pause menu when using a controller
[*]  Fixed the issue where team level-related achievements could not be completed under certain circumstances
[*]  Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

For players using custom tracks, please remember to create a txt file with the same name as the mp3 file and enter the BPM (beats per minute) value of the track. Otherwise, the track will not play properly. For more details, please refer to the readme file in the directory.

We will continue to improve the game. Please stay tuned.

Thank you so much for your support.
GameSmith
